description: List the URLs on a website without scraping their content. Suited to showing a site's pages, mapping a site, or picking a subset of URLs to scrape. `create_crawl` both discovers and scrapes pages when their content is needed too.

search_query.description: Optional search query to filter URLs (e.g., "blog").

top_n.description: Optional limit for number of URLs returned.

url.description: Website URL to extract links from.

name: create_map
title: Create Map
